title: Constant-source coherent transformation spaces as sections of a mapping family
statement:
Use the quasicategories, internal functor simplicial sets, coherent transformations and right-pinched mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the space-valued transport and coherent mapping bifunctor $H_{\mathcal E}$ of [lem-coef-space-transport-classification]. Fix universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'$. Let $J$ be a $\mathcal U$-small simplicial set, let $\mathcal E$ be a $\mathcal U'$-small quasicategory with $\mathcal U$-small mapping spaces, let $p:J\to\mathcal E$ be a coherent diagram, and let $x$ be an object of $\mathcal E$. Put $F_{x,p}=H_{\mathcal E}(x,p(-)):J\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$ and write $\Delta_Jx$ and $\Delta_J*$ for the constant diagrams at $x$ and at the one-point space, respectively. Define $q_{x,p}:A_{x,p}\to J$ as the pullback along $p$ of the source-fixed arrow left fibration $\{x\}\times_{\mathcal E,\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,\mathcal E)\to\mathcal E$, where the last projection is $\operatorname{ev}_1$. Define $\Gamma_J(q_{x,p})$ to be the simplicial set whose $n$-simplices are maps $s:J\times\Delta^n\to A_{x,p}$ over the projection to $J$. There are equivalences of Kan complexes
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(J,\mathcal E)}(\Delta_Jx,p)\simeq\Gamma_J(q_{x,p})\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(J,\mathcal S_{\mathcal U})}(\Delta_J*,F_{x,p}).$$
These comparisons are coherent in $x$ contravariantly and in $p$ covariantly, and compatible with restriction along maps of small indexing simplicial sets. They identify a transformation $b:\Delta_Jx\to p$ with the section whose values are its arrows $b_j:x\to p(j)$, retaining every higher simplex. In particular, for a cone $\lambda:\Delta_Jl\to p$, postcomposition $f\mapsto\lambda\circ\Delta_Jf$ corresponds on the right to the coherent family $f\mapsto(\lambda_j\circ f)_{j\in J}$, on the entire space $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal E}(x,l)$. The total space $A_{x,p}$ need only be $\mathcal U'$-small; its section space has a $\mathcal U$-small Kan model. Empty $J$ and empty mapping spaces are allowed.
